summary: SBIN Quote: a full L1 quote, then a zlib-compressed L1 trade delta merged into it; the book totals are left out (they come only on L5), and a tick after the unsubscribe reaches nobody.

notes: Field values follow the web test's L1 (SBIN 810.5, chngPer 0.68), sent as Tradejini's binary L1 packet.

last_trade_time: the web formats the trade time in its server's local zone (nxtradstream.py datefmt, datetime.fromtimestamp); the desktop always formats it in IST (lead ruling 2026-11-09, IST everywhere), and the glue pins IST, so the two match here. A web server not set to IST sends another text for the same trade: a web defect (the time depends on where the server runs).

deviations.reason: Tradejini sends the trade time in epoch seconds; the web formats it with the server's local time zone into a text such as "2025-11-05 14:25:31" (nxtradstream.py datefmt) and sends that as ltt, where feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends epoch ms, and leaves ltt out when Tradejini sent no trade time, where the web sends null (Quote, Depth) or "" (LTP).
An equity's L1 carries no OI; the web sends oi 0 in Quote (message.get("OI", 0)). The desktop leaves out a field the stream did not carry (web openalgo#2376).
